text:
- [LLEX.11.2.2] **Exponent is optional** on the dotted form; required on the
  bare form (to disambiguate from `INT_LIT`).

idris.name: llex_11_2__float_lit
idris.note: The exponent optional on the dotted form and required on the bare one: a bare `DEC_LIT` is no `FLOAT_LIT`, and `lcst_4_5_8__parse_float` reads it as an `INT_LIT`.
